_about: Trust tiers used by tools/apply.mjs. A result is published only when confirmed: one Tier 1 source, OR one 'enough alone' source, OR two Tier 2 sources from different sites, OR one Tier 2 plus one Tier 3. Tier 3 never counts on its own. Matching is by site (sub-domains included). Sources must be independent: an article that credits a news agency (e.g. '— QNA', '(WAM)', 'قنا', 'وام', 'كونا') counts as that agency, so never list it next to the agency's own report as a second source.

tier1.uaeproleague.ae: UAE Pro League — official organiser of the ADNOC Pro League, ADIB Cup and EMAAR Super Cup
tier1.uaefa.ae: UAE Football Association — official organiser of the UAE President's Cup
tier1.the-afc.com: Asian Football Confederation — official (ACL Elite, ACL Two, Asian Cup)
tier1.agcff.org: Arab Gulf Cup Football Federation — official (Gulf Club Champions League)
tier1.spl.com.sa: Saudi Pro League — official organiser of the Roshn Saudi League (names, stadiums, regulations, news and schedule PDFs read well; its results and match pages load with JavaScript and show nothing to the reader)
tier1.saff.com.sa: Saudi Arabian Football Federation — official organiser of the King's Cup and the Saudi Super Cup (some pages unreliable to the reader)
tier1.bundesliga.com: DFL (Deutsche Fußball Liga) — official site of the Bundesliga (matchday pages read well: fixtures, kick-off times, results)
tier1.dfb.de: German Football Association (DFB) — official organiser of the DFB-Pokal
tier1.legaseriea.it: Lega Serie A — official organiser of Serie A and the Coppa Italia

enoughAlone._note: Not organisers, but enough on their own by Mohamed's decision (24 Oct 2026). The page must be about this fixture: check its date, season and both teams (searches also return older meetings of the same teams).
enoughAlone.kooora.com: Kooora (كووورة) — Arabic football newsroom and match centre. Most current pages have very long Arabic addresses the reader refuses; short kooora.com/?n=… links open.
enoughAlone.365scores.com: 365Scores — results app. Scores checked right (LALIGA round 9, all 10), but the copy the reader gets can be a day or more old: a page still showing 'scheduled' or 'today' isn't evidence.

tier2.skysports.com: Sky Sports — results, fixtures and tables for European football
tier2.site.api.espn.com: ESPN data feed (same data as espn.com)
tier2.wam.ae: WAM — Emirates News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.aletihad.ae: Al Ittihad (Abu Dhabi) incl. its English edition, which carries WAM reports
tier2.kuna.net.kw: KUNA — Kuwait News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.bna.bh: BNA — Bahrain News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.omannews.gov.om: ONA — Oman News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.ina.iq: INA — Iraqi News Agency (state news agency)

tier3.thesportsdb.com: TheSportsDB — community-maintained; good for fixture lists, cross-check only
tier3.rsssf.org: RSSSF — football statistics archive; reliable but updated after the fact
